_comment: ADOPT: the environment seam (rc.39 · flow-plan Phase 5.1) — mounted as docs/governance/environments.json and validated by scripts/environments-check.mjs. Environments were the one cross-cutting concept in this bundle that existed only as PROSE: three `<!-- ADOPT -->` comments in skills/release/SKILL.md told an adopter to 'name your pre-production target' and nothing anywhere could check what they named. A promotion ladder that lives in a comment cannot be reasoned about by a gate, cannot be cited by a deployment record, and cannot tell you which environments hold personal data. This file is that ladder, written down: one entry per environment, each naming what it is for, what class of data it may hold, who may promote INTO it, and where it is promoted FROM. The ladder is a chain: exactly one root (promotion_source null), every other environment naming a declared source, and no cycles. Two rules fail closed and are the reason this is a control rather than documentation: an environment holding `personal` data must require approval, and the terminal environment (the one nothing promotes out of — production) must require approval. ADOPT every field; the placeholders below are a WORKED SHAPE for a three-rung ladder, not your ladder.

environments.purpose: Integration of merged work; the first place a built artifact runs at all
Pre-production rehearsal: the release skill's smoke suite runs HERE, against this live URL
Customer-facing. Promotion into it is delivery step ⑧ and happens only on a returned compound production authorization
